name: fat-gripz-dumbbell-farmers-carry
instructions:
1. Wrap a set of fat gripz around a pair of dumbbells and grasp them using a neutral grip.
2. While maintaining an active shoulder position, hold the dumbbells by your side and walk for a designated distance or amount of time.
